Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates (see text); you cover a solid surface with a layer of sticky glue; anyone in the area when the spell is cast must succeed at a Reflex save or become entangled; an entangled creature can break free by succeeding at a combat maneuver check or an Escape Artist check as a standard action (DC = the spell's DC); the area of the spell is difficult terrain; a creature moving through the glue must succeed at a combat maneuver check or an Escape Artist check as part of its move action (DC = the spell's DC), or it loses its movement and becomes entangled in the first square it enters; the spell can instead create a sticky coating on an item, and a creature holding the targeted item may attempt a Reflex save against the spell's DC — if this save succeeds the item is unaffected, if it fails the item is stuck in place; an affected item connected to another item (such as a sword in a sheath) cannot be separated unless a creature succeeds at a combat maneuver check or a Strength check as a move action (DC = the spell's DC); a creature must succeed at a save each time it attempts to use a sticky item, or the item becomes stuck to the creature; sticky armor or clothing imposes a -[[10]] circumstance penalty on Escape Artist checks and combat maneuver checks made to escape a grapple, and to the wearer's CMD to avoid being grappled; spell resistance: no

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates (see text); a layer of slippery grease covers a solid surface; a creature can walk within or through the area at half normal speed with a successful DC [[10]] Acrobatics check; failure means it can't move that round and must then attempt a Reflex save or fall, while failure by [[5]] or more means it falls; creatures that do not move on their turn need not attempt this check and are not considered flat-footed; material objects not in use are always affected by this spell, while an object wielded or employed by a creature requires its bearer to succeed at a Reflex save to avoid dropping it, and a new save must be made each round the creature attempts to pick up or use the greased item; a creature wearing greased armor or clothing gains a +[[10]] circumstance bonus on Escape Artist checks and combat maneuver checks made to escape a grapple, and to its CMD to avoid being grappled; [[10]]-ft. square area; spell resistance: no

Range: [[25 + 5*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; the target takes a -[[10]] penalty on Sense Motive checks for [[ 10*@spells.primary.cl.total ]] minutes; creatures that attempt to lie to or deceive the target gain a +[[10]] bonus on their Bluff checks; the believability of any lie told to the target increases by one step (an impossible lie seems far-fetched, a far-fetched lie seems unlikely, an unlikely lie seems believable); a creature gains no benefit from glibness on Bluff checks to lie to or deceive a creature under the effects of this spell; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[60]] ft; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; a severe blast of air (approximately [[50]] mph) originates from you, affecting all creatures in its path; flying creatures take a -[[4]] penalty on Fly skill checks; a Tiny or smaller flying creature that fails a DC [[25]] Fly check is blown back [[2d6]] x [[10]] feet and takes [[2d6]] points of damage; a Small or smaller flying creature must succeed at a DC [[20]] Fly check to move against the wind; a Tiny or smaller creature on the ground is knocked down and rolls [[1d4]] x [[10]] feet, taking [[1d4]] points of nonlethal damage per [[10]] feet rolled; Small creatures on the ground are knocked prone; Medium or smaller creatures cannot move forward against the wind unless they succeed at a DC [[15]] Strength check; Large or larger creatures may move normally; this spell cannot move a creature beyond the limit of its range; any creature, regardless of size, takes a -[[4]] penalty on ranged attacks and Perception checks in the area; unprotected flames such as candles and torches are automatically extinguished, while protected flames (such as those in lanterns) dance wildly and have a [[50]]% chance to be extinguished; the spell can also stir up sand or dust, fan a large fire, overturn delicate awnings or hangings, heel over a small boat, or blow gases or vapors to the edge of its range; can be made permanent with a permanency spell; spell resistance: yes

save.description: negates (object) or Reflex negates; see text

riders: Range: [[100 + 10*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates (object) or Reflex negates; see text; a swirling ball of wind rolls in whichever direction you point, treated in all ways as an area of severe wind, applying a -[[4]] penalty on ranged weapon attacks that pass through it; the sphere moves [[30]] feet per round and can ascend or jump up to [[30]] feet as part of that movement to strike a target; if it enters a space containing a Medium or smaller creature, it stops moving for the round and generates a sharp thrust of wind to bull rush the creature, using your caster level in place of its base attack bonus with a +[[2]] bonus for its Strength score; whether or not the bull rush succeeds, the creature takes [[1d6]] points of nonlethal bludgeoning damage; if the bull rush fails, the creature remains subject to the severe wind as long as it stays in the sphere's square; the sphere rolls over objects or barriers less than [[4]] feet tall; it moves only while you actively direct it as a move action, otherwise it stays at rest; the sphere immediately dissipates if it exceeds the spell's range; spell resistance: yes

Range: touch; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half; you charge the subject with negative energy, dealing [[ min(150, 10*@spells.primary.cl.total) ]] points of damage; this damage cannot reduce the target's hit points below [[1]]; if used on an undead creature, this spell instead heals the creature for the same amount; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[20]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] partial; an illusion of misty vapor inhabited by shadowy shapes arises around you and is stationary; the mist obscures all sight, including darkvision, beyond [[5]] feet; a creature [[5]] feet away has concealment ([[20]]% miss chance); creatures farther away have total concealment ([[50]]% miss chance, and the attacker cannot use sight to locate the target); creatures within the mist take [[1d2]] points of Wisdom damage and gain the shaken condition, which lasts as long as the creature remains in the mist; spell resistance: no

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; as part of casting this spell, you may attempt a single Intimidate check to make the target act friendly toward you; if successful, the target assists you normally but remains fearful of your retribution even after its attitude shifts to unfriendly; if the creature reports your coercion to authorities, attacks you, or otherwise acts in a way that purposefully threatens you or your objectives (at the GM's discretion), the spell triggers, inflicting the creature with the unshakable certainty that you will find and punish it; this imposes the shaken condition on the creature for [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] days; during this time the creature takes a -[[2]] penalty on saving throws against spells you cast with the fear descriptor; spell resistance: yes

Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; you badger and nitpick the subject until its mood sours; the target's attitude shifts one category toward hostile regarding you and everyone within [[30]] feet of the target at the time the spell is cast; the target also takes a -[[2]] penalty on attack rolls, on saving throws, and on ability and skill checks that rely on Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, for [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] minutes; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; the subject collapses into gales of uncontrollable manic laughter, falls prone, and can take no actions (but is not considered helpless) for up to [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] rounds; on its next turn, it may attempt a new save as a full-round action (which does not provoke attacks of opportunity) to end the effect early, after which it can act normally; a creature with an Intelligence score of [[2]] or lower is not affected; a creature whose type differs from the caster's gains a +[[4]] bonus on its saving throw, because humor doesn't 'translate' well; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[100 + 10*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; functions like hold person, except it affects any living creature that fails its Will save; the target becomes paralyzed and freezes in place for [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] rounds; it is aware and breathes normally but cannot take any actions, even speech; each round on its turn it may attempt a new save, a full-round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, to end the effect; a winged creature that is paralyzed cannot flap its wings and falls; a swimmer cannot swim and may drown; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[100 + 10*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; the humanoid subject becomes paralyzed and freezes in place for [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] rounds; it is aware and breathes normally but cannot take any actions, even speech; each round on its turn it may attempt a new save, a full-round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, to end the effect; a winged creature that is paralyzed cannot flap its wings and falls; a swimmer cannot swim and may drown; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[400 + 40*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half; moisture evaporates from the body of each subject living creature, causing flesh to wither, crack, and crumble to dust; affects living creatures, no two of which can be more than [[60]] feet apart; deals [[ (min(20, @spells.primary.cl.total))d6 ]] damage to most living creatures; is especially devastating to water elementals and plant creatures, which instead take [[ (min(20, @spells.primary.cl.total))d8 ]] damage; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; you levitate the target a few inches off the ground, removing its solid footing and halving its speed; the target takes a -[[4]] penalty to CMD against bull rush, drag, and reposition attempts; a targeted creature that attacks with a melee or ranged weapon becomes increasingly unstable: the first such attack takes a -[[1]] penalty on the attack roll, the second -[[2]], and so on to a maximum penalty of -[[5]]; spending a full-round action to stabilize allows the creature to begin again at -[[1]]; this spell fails if cast on a flying creature; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] partial; you create a blast of intense cold, coating all solid surfaces in the area with a thin coating of ice; any creature in the area when the spell is cast takes [[ 1d6 + min(10, @spells.primary.cl.total) ]] points of cold damage and falls prone; a creature can walk within or through the area at half its normal speed with a successful DC [[10]] Acrobatics check; failure by [[4]] or less means the creature can't move that round and must succeed at a Reflex save or fall, while failure by [[5]] or more means it falls; creatures that do not move on their turn need not attempt this check; a [[5]]-foot square of ice has hardness [[0]] and [[3]] hit points; though the initial burst is instantaneous, the ice persists as nonmagical terrain for [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] minutes under temperate conditions (possibly only half as long in tropical environments, or indefinitely in cold environments where ice and snow persist without melting); spell resistance: see text (applies only to the initial cold damage and knockdown)

Range: [[400 + 40*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; great magical hailstones pound down as the spell is cast, dealing [[3d6]] points of bludgeoning damage and [[2d6]] points of cold damage to every creature in the area; this damage occurs only once, when the spell is cast; for the remainder of the spell's duration, heavy snow and sleet rain down in the area, imposing a -[[4]] penalty on Perception checks and treating the entire area as difficult terrain; at the end of the duration the snow and hail disappear, leaving no aftereffects other than the damage already dealt; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] partial; you make the target unconsciously desire a goal you define when you cast this spell; the DC of any Diplomacy check to ask the target to act in a way it believes leads toward that goal decreases by [[5]]; the target takes a -[[2]] penalty on saving throws against mind-affecting effects that compel it to act in a way it believes leads toward that goal; spells that reveal the target's goals or thoughts reveal the implanted urge as its most important goal, and the target does not register as thinking of anything else as long as it is presented with the focus of its urge or a way to move toward it; anyone studying the target's thoughts can notice the implanted nature of this urge with a successful caster level check; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[100 + 10*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half; a cloud of roiling smoke shot through with white-hot embers obscures all sight as a fog cloud does; the embers deal [[6d6]] points of fire damage to everything within the cloud on your turn each round; as with cloudkill, the smoke moves away from you at [[10]] feet per round (recalculating its spread each round from its new point of origin), or you may concentrate to move it as much as [[60]] feet per round; any portion of the cloud that would extend beyond your maximum range dissipates harmlessly, reducing the remainder's spread thereafter; wind disperses the smoke, and the spell cannot be cast underwater; spell resistance: no

Range: touch; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half; laying your hand upon a creature, you channel negative energy dealing [[ 1d8 + min(5, @spells.primary.cl.total) ]] points of damage; since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell instead cures such a creature of a like amount of damage rather than harming it; spell resistance: yes
Range: melee touch; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half; a living target that fails its save is sickened for [[ min(10, @spells.primary.cl.total) ]] rounds; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] partial; you telepathically wrack the target's mind and body with agonizing pain, imposing a -[[4]] penalty on attack rolls, skill checks, and ability checks for [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] rounds; a successful Will save reduces the duration of this penalty to [[1]] round; spell resistance: yes
Range: melee touch; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half; a living target that fails its save is sickened for [[ min(15, @spells.primary.cl.total) ]] rounds; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[100 + 10*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; the affected creature suffers a continuous confusion effect, as the confusion spell; remove curse does not remove this insanity; only greater restoration, heal, limited wish, miracle, or wish can restore the creature; spell resistance: yes

Range: touch; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; you may ask [[ floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2) ]] questions; for each question, the target either answers or takes [[1d4]] damage plus your Wisdom bonus; the target is not compelled to answer truthfully, but it takes a -[[4]] penalty on Bluff checks to convince you when it is lying; spell resistance: yes

on a successful ranged touch attack, the target's skeleton or exoskeleton turns into jagged shards of cold iron; whenever the target moves, it takes [[1d6]] points of piercing damage and is sickened for [[1]] round as the spines stab into it, and this damage overcomes damage reduction as though it were a weapon of cold iron and magic; a creature affected by this spell can choose to remain motionless to avoid taking damage; a target with DR/cold iron or DR/cold iron and magic is nauseated instead of sickened; this spell has no effect on a creature that has neither a skeleton nor a hard carapace; spell resistance: yes

Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] partial; the stake requires a ranged touch attack to strike and is treated as a magic cold iron weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction, dealing [[ (floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2))d6 ]] points of piercing damage; if a creature with DR/cold iron takes damage from this spell, it is sickened for [[1]] round and must attempt a Fortitude save; on a failed save, for [[ @spells.primary.cl.total ]] rounds the target must succeed at a concentration check (in addition to any normally required concentration checks) to use any of its spells or spell-like abilities, with the check DC equal to [[15]] plus twice the level of the spell being cast; if the target fails the check, its spell is wasted; spell resistance: no

save.description: partial (a successful save reduces the duration to [[1]] round)

riders: Range: touch; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] partial (a successful save reduces the duration to [[1]] round); the target is compelled to do nothing but caper and prance in place; it takes a -[[4]] penalty to Armor Class and a -[[10]] penalty on Reflex saves, and it negates any AC bonus granted by a shield it holds; it provokes attacks of opportunity each round on its turn; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; affects only a living creature with [[5]] HD or fewer; unless the target scratches as a move action, it takes a -[[1]] penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; a creature enclosed in the light prison can attack, cast spells, and otherwise act normally as long as it stays within the prison; if a creature passes through the walls of a light prison enclosing it, it takes [[1d6]] damage and is blinded for [[1]] round, with no saving throw against these effects; once a creature passes through the walls of the light prison surrounding it, the effect ends for that creature; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[120]] ft; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half; deals [[ (min(10, @spells.primary.cl.total))d6 ]] electricity damage to each creature in a [[120]]-ft. line originating at your fingertips; the bolt sets fire to combustibles and damages objects in its path, and can melt metals with a low melting point such as lead, gold, copper, silver, or bronze; if the damage caused to an interposing barrier shatters or breaks through it, the bolt may continue beyond the barrier if the spell's range permits, otherwise it stops at the barrier as any other spell effect does; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates (object); the target object becomes a liquid version of itself and drips or runs like a thin oil until it pools on a flat surface; if it has magical or alchemical properties, they become inert for the duration; if you are holding the item when you cast this spell, you can drain it into the bottle used as the spell's focus, and an item with hit point damage or the broken condition regains [[ 5*@spells.primary.cl.total ]] hit points if drained into a bottle this way; the duration of temporary effects on the object (such as applied poison or greater magic weapon) passes normally and may expire while it is in liquid form; if a creature drinks the liquid and the spell then ends, that creature takes [[3d6]] damage and brings up the solid version of the item as a standard action in a coughing fit; any spell or effect that would disperse or dilute the object forces it to attempt a Fortitude save (using that effect's DC, or DC [[15]] for effects with no save of their own, such as pouring the liquid into a stream), and a failed save gives the object the broken condition (or destroys it if it is already broken); no effect on artifacts, constructs, or intelligent magic items; spell resistance: no

Range: [[25 + 5*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; the target takes a -[[2]] penalty on Will saving throws, caster level checks, Intelligence-based skill checks, and Wisdom-based skill checks; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; summons a swarm of screeching, mischievous monkeys with the statistics of a monkey swarm that understands and obeys your commands; creatures failing a saving throw against the swarm's distraction attack are deafened for [[1]] minute as well as nauseated; the monkeys attempt one disarm or steal combat maneuver each turn as a free action against any creature that begins its turn in the swarm, using your caster level plus your casting ability score bonus (Intelligence for wizards, Wisdom for druids, Charisma for bards, sorcerers, and summoners) as their CMB; recovering an item from the monkeys requires a successful disarm or steal attempt against that CMB + [[10]]; an object stolen by the monkeys takes swarm damage each round the swarm remains in possession of it; spell resistance: no

Range: [[25 + 5*floor(@spells.primary.cl.total/2)]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; targets only creatures with the ooze type, creatures with the amorphous special ability, and non-bipedal creatures with a special association with the Outer Gods, no two of which may be more than [[30]] ft. apart; draws the targets' attention to you as per the fascinate bardic performance ability; it affects mindless creatures despite the mindless quality normally granting immunity to mind-affecting effects, though it does not ignore any other immunity to mind-affecting effects a creature might have; you do not need to maintain the effect each round, as the music continues for the spell's duration; creatures fascinated by this spell become immune to any other casting of it for [[24]] hours after the spell ends, and the spell ends for all targets if the fascination breaks on any of them for any reason (such as an attack); if you have the bardic performance class feature and the fascinate bardic performance, you can choose to use the spell's save DC or a DC equal to [[10]] plus half your levels in the class that grants bardic performance plus your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher; if you use the latter DC, each round of the melody costs [[1]] round of bardic performance and counts as an active performance for determining how many performances you can have active; each time you cast this spell you take [[1d4]] Wisdom damage, or [[2d6]] sanity damage instead if your campaign uses the sanity system; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[30]] ft; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates (object; see text); unattended metal objects within range - including weapons, armor, and anything made primarily of metal - are pulled violently toward you, stopping just short of your space and falling harmlessly to the ground; objects secured to a nonmetallic fixture remain where they are unless a forceful tug would be enough to detach them; loose objects weighing more than [[500]] pounds are not affected; if the magnetic field would cause a dangerous metal object such as a sword or anvil to intersect a square occupied by a creature, that creature must succeed at a Reflex save or take damage as if from an improvised weapon of the object's size; a creature in the area wearing metal armor, wielding a metal weapon, or holding a metal object must succeed at a Reflex save or be dragged [[5]] feet closer to you in a straight line, as if affected by the pull universal monster rule; a creature can drop a metal object it's holding as a free action to avoid the effect if it's not wearing metal armor, and a creature being dragged by its shield can loosen it as a move action and drop it as a free action; creatures made entirely or mostly of metal take a -[[2]] penalty on their Reflex saves; a creature that fails its save by [[5]] or more is pulled an additional [[5]] feet closer for every increment of [[5]] by which it failed its save; spell resistance: yes (object)

Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; on a successful ranged touch attack, you burn your handprint onto exposed flesh of the target, typically the head or forearm, dealing [[1d6]] points of acid damage, and the flesh around the handprint becomes rough and scaly like the hide of a lizard; the mark glows with a green radiance (shedding light as a torch) when brought within [[60]] feet of you, and while it glows the target takes a -[[2]] penalty to AC against your attacks and on saving throws to resist any spell you cast or spell-like ability you use; each day the target remains cursed, more of its flesh becomes covered in reptilian scales, and it must succeed at a Fortitude save each day or take [[1d4]] points of Charisma damage, [[1]] point of which is Charisma drain instead; a creature reduced to [[0]] Charisma by this effect is immediately transformed into a small, harmless cave lizard, as the baleful polymorph spell; the curse cannot be dispelled, but it can be removed with break enchantment, limited wish, miracle, remove curse, or wish; spell resistance: yes

save.description: negates, then Reflex partial each round thereafter (see text)

riders: Range: [[25 + 5*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates, then Reflex partial each round thereafter (see text); if the target fails its Will save, it takes [[1d4]] points of Strength damage as a quasi-real shadow manifests in its space and attacks it, and this shadow remains attached to the target and moves wherever the target moves; at the start of each subsequent round the target must succeed at a Reflex save or take [[1d4]] additional points of Strength damage, and a successful save reduces the Strength damage to [[1]] point; if the target's Strength score is reduced to [[0]] by this spell's effects, it dies; if the target is in bright light, it gains a +[[2]] bonus on Reflex saves against this spell, and if the target is in darkness, it takes a -[[2]] penalty on Reflex saves against this spell; spell resistance: yes

Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; a wave of necromantic energy pulses from you in a [[5]]-ft.-wide, [[60]]-ft.-long line, ripping the souls from the bodies of those it kills, which manifest as screaming, transparent versions of the affected creatures; the wave kills every living creature of [[17]] or fewer HD in the line, starting with the creature closest to you, up to a maximum of [[ (1d4)*@spells.primary.cl.total ]] HD of creatures; no creature of [[18]] or more HD can be affected; a creature that succeeds at its saving throw or has too many HD does not count against the HD the spell can kill; the wave continues affecting creatures as it rolls away from you until you either run out of HD to affect or reach the limit of the spell's area; if the spell does not kill any creatures, the unreleased necromantic energy violently explodes in the final square of the [[60]]-ft. line, dealing [[ 10d6 + @spells.primary.cl.total ]] damage to any creature in that square with no saving throw; if several creatures occupy the same square, one is randomly determined to be affected; spell resistance: yes

save.description: half (or none against a direct hit's [[2d6]] bludgeoning damage; see text)

riders: Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] half (or none against a direct hit's [[2d6]] bludgeoning damage; see text); four [[2]]-foot-diameter meteor spheres spring from your outstretched hand and streak in straight lines to the spots you select, leaving a fiery trail of sparks; if you aim a sphere at a specific creature, you may make a ranged touch attack to strike the target with the meteor, and any creature struck by a sphere takes [[2d6]] points of bludgeoning damage (no save) and takes a -[[4]] penalty on the saving throw against that sphere's fire damage; if a targeted sphere misses its target, it explodes at the nearest corner of the target's space instead; you may aim more than one sphere at the same target; once a sphere reaches its destination, it explodes in a [[40]]-foot-radius spread, dealing [[6d6]] points of fire damage to each creature in the area; if a creature is within the area of more than one sphere, it must save separately against each, and despite stemming from separate spheres, all of the fire damage is added together after the saves have been made, with fire resistance applied only once; spell resistance: yes

Range: [[100 + 10*@spells.primary.cl.total]] ft; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + @slvl + @castMod ]] negates; creatures in the mind fog take a -[[10]] penalty on Wisdom checks and Will saves for as long as they remain in the fog and for [[2d6]] rounds thereafter; a creature that successfully saves against the fog is not affected and need not make further saves even if it remains in the fog; the fog is stationary and lasts for [[30]] minutes or until dispersed by wind - a moderate wind ([[11]]+ mph) disperses the fog in [[4]] rounds, a strong wind ([[21]]+ mph) disperses the fog in [[1]] round; the fog is thin and does not significantly hamper vision; spell resistance: yes
